Definition: a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between)
BiblicalUsage: 1) wheel, disc; 1a) potter's wheel; 1b) bearing-stool, midwife's stool
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
